# manual-case-dxa-reflection.txt -- #5703
#
# Generated by (paths shown relative to <repo>):
#   $ <repo>/build/Release/bin/dxc.exe -T lib_6_3 -O3 -Fo lib-main.dxo repro.hlsl
#   $ <repo>/build/Release/bin/dxl.exe -T cs_6_3 -E main -O3 -Fo linked-main.dxo lib-main.dxo
#   $ <repo>/build/Release/bin/dxa.exe -dumpreflection linked-main.dxo
#
# compiler: <repo>/build/Release/bin/dxc.exe --version
#   dxcompiler.dll: 1.10(5440-677a02a1)(1.9.0.15438) - 1.9.0.15438 (main, 89e2f98e2)
# ground truth git commit: 89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df (exact self-report)
#
# Purpose: the linked container (`linked-main.dxo`, produced the same way as
# the primary repro's "linked" stage) has NO RDAT part -- confirmed by
# link5703.py's container parser (see out-main-debug-link5703.txt). This
# capture answers a different question: is the *reflection information
# itself* actually gone, or just the RDAT part specifically? `dxa
# -dumpreflection` drives dxcompiler's own `ID3D12ShaderReflection` (the
# ordinary, non-library reflection interface -- distinct from
# `ID3D12LibraryReflection`, which is what RDAT feeds) over the same
# container.
#
# Result: ID3D12ShaderReflection resolves both bound resources correctly --
# texResource at t900/space0 and rwTexResource at u0/space2400 -- with the
# right D3D_SIT_* / D3D_RETURN_TYPE_* / D3D_SRV_DIMENSION_* values, and
# reports InstructionCount 9 / 1 texture-load / 1 UAV-typed-store, matching
# the repro's single Load+store body. Nothing about resource-binding
# reflection is lost by RDAT's absence: ID3D12ShaderReflection reads this
# from PSV0 + DXIL metadata instead, exactly as it would for a shader that
# was never a library at all.
